scheme_name: Assistance for Installation of Sprinkler / Drip Micro Irrigation Systems
other_conditions: Farmers must own cultivable agricultural land in the Union Territory of Puducherry along with their own or leased tubewell and adequate water‑pumping system
Applicants who have already received the maximum subsidy for sprinkler irrigation in the past 10 years or for drip irrigation in the past 8 years are not eligible
If a micro‑irrigation system has already been installed, the balance of the subsidy may be provided after deducting previously received assistance
Land on which a micro‑irrigation system was installed in the last 10 years (sprinkler) or 8 years (drip) is excluded even if ownership changes
Farmers who have previously installed sprinkler systems can apply for drip systems and vice‑versa provided they intend to cultivate intercrop for 3 years
Eligibility category noted in source: Marginal Farmer
Eligibility category noted in source: Small Farmer
Eligibility category noted in source: Scheduled Caste Farmer
Eligibility category noted in source: Scheduled Tribe Farmer
Eligibility category noted in source: Women Farmer
Eligibility category noted in source: Big Farmer
Eligibility category noted in source: Institution
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of up to 90% (capped at ₹25,000 per hectare) for marginal, small, SC/ST and women farmers, and up to 70% (capped at ₹25,000 per hectare) for big farmers and institutions.
